title: Picking up a second 'cask of Ironbound cinder-oil' (one from Cobb at Wickstead's cart lot, one from Slade at Pennywell's furnace-yard) creates two separate inventory lines with two different flavor-text descriptions instead of stacking into one item with a quantity, cluttering the carry list for the rest of the game.
where: The Cart Lot (Fallows) and The Furnace-Yard (Pennywell)
